notes.title: Update Notes December 17th
notes.notes:
[h2]Highlights:[/h2]

- The room code should now stay the same when returning from match to lobby

- Changes to reconnects:
[list]
    [*] You can now rejoin an ongoing match via room code if the game crashed
    [*] You can now rejoin an ongoing match via room code if you went back to main menu
    [*] The host can now extend the wait timer
[/list]    
    ⚠️ If the timer expires, or the host player cancels waiting, the reconnect attempt will still be blocked, and the player will be removed from the ongoing match permanently! ⚠️
    

[h2]Fixes & changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Lobby] Fixed chat scrolling sensitivity
[*] [Lobby] Now the host’s lobby setting page will not be refreshed by others’ actions in the lobby
[*] [Lobby] Fixed a rare crash when syncing a drawing to players that left
[*] We don’t disable the mute button on players that disconnected during a match anymore
[*] [Whisper] Fix a bug where in rare cases after a reconnect, an old guess was automatically re-submitted in a later round
[*] [Whisper] Fix a bug where a full image could be sent twice when the drawing phase ended, which lead to unnecessary network burden
[*] [Whisper] Avoid sending very large images in full when drawing phase ended, and rely on only syncing all lines while they are drawn
[*] [Whisper] Fixed an issue that the presentation intro could have different orders for different player (so sometimes they did not show the correct intro for the following presentation)
[*] [Whisper] Fix a stuck case when a word match vote was lost due to a disconnect during a later presentation
[/list]

notes.title: Important: Wordlist Changes
notes.notes:
As we prepare to release our upcoming major update this year, wordlists will no longer work as we know now.

Here's what you need to know to prepare for this change:

[h3]Current Wordlists[/h3]
At the moment, wordlists are published on Steam and other players can interact with them via Steam.

[h3]New Wordlists[/h3]
As of [b]January 28[/b], wordlists will be hosted on our own wordlist service. Players can still publish wordlists on Steam, but they will not appear in the new version of the game.

We’re currently fetching wordlists on Steam and migrating them, but [b]any new wordlists as of January 28 will not be migrated to the new version[/b].

You will be able to publish and update wordlists for the new version as soon as that is available!

If you have any questions about this process or if you need any help, feel free to reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/8neSVvanqM]Discord[/url]!

We’re excited about this major update and we can’t wait to share more about it! Make sure you’re tuned to our channels until we’re ready for release this year.

notes.title: Important: Player Name Changes
notes.notes:
In preparation for the major update planned for early 2024, you will have the chance to secure your unique player name in December 2023.

Here's what you need to know to prepare for this:

[h3][u][b]Current Player Names[/b][/u][/h3]
Currently, player names shown in-game are the same ones you use for Steam. This is currently acting as a limitation for some of the plans we have for this major update, so we’re switching to our own system where every player name will be [b]unique[/b].

[h3][u][b]New Player Names[/b][/u][/h3]
As we enter this transition period from our current version into the 2024 version, we’re releasing an update in [b]December[/b] that allows everyone to register their favorite player name before the release of the 2024 version.

You can still pick a new player name once the 2024 version is out if you don’t manage to participate in the reservation period.

[h3][u][b]Reservation Instructions[/b][/u][/h3]
[olist]
[*]Make sure your game is up to date so you’ll be able to see the countdown on the top right corner of the main screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/ab89fae2ba05cad6babd407156580b6a733c2f1e.png[/img]
[*]Once the player name reservation is available, if your game is up to date with the latest version, this notification will change to something like this: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/de471675d0b4e9c554d7e336b1903aa9fde1005c.png[/img]
[*]By clicking on the button to reserve your player name, this pop-up will appear:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/a991814eef3a7e4d97f2a15abd36a0890b6e2da1.png[/img]
[*]After entering a valid name, click on ‘register’ to confirm and the window will show the following:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/f021cdc56710a4f3f712599417c53ce4eb3da017.png[/img]
[*]This should confirm your name reservation. If you wish to change your name, don’t worry, simply click on the ‘edit’ button.
[/olist]

If you have any questions about this process or if you need any help, feel free to reach out to us at [url=https://discord.gg/8neSVvanqM]Discord[/url]!

We’re excited about this major update and we can’t wait to share more about it! Make sure you’re tuned to our channels as we’re sharing our progress over time until we’re ready for release in 2024.

notes.title: Announcing: New & Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
Today we don't have an update for you, but we want to announce some pretty exciting news about the future of Draw & Guess! 

We are thrilled to share with you what we’ve been working on for a while now. Aside from networking improvements, our team has been putting a lot of effort into developing a fully revamped version of the game!

With this new version of Draw & Guess, we’re not only improving our current features, but we’re also updating the entire interface and adding new tools that have been long requested by our amazing community.

The update will make the gaming experience more fluid and will also allow you to express your creative skills better. 🎨

Among these changes, here are some spoilers: colour palettes, layers, sketchbook, and [i]much more[/i]! We will share updates in the coming months, so make sure to stay tuned to our channels 👀

Today we will kick off by showing you a brand new addition: [b]Colour Palettes[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/ea357a6806bedc4ee853593b603b6e3f2789d313.png[/img]

This is still a work in progress so we would love to hear your thoughts. Feel free to share your feedback with us on our [url=discord.gg/kzcJk7RUws]official Discord server[/url]! Our main priority with this update is to provide a better experience to our players. 

We really appreciate all your support to Draw & Guess so far and we hope you enjoy this update just as much as we are enjoying working on it!

You can stay tuned to our [url=discord.gg/kzcJk7RUws]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Draw_Guess]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@drawguessgame]TikTok[/url] as we’ll continue to share our progress over time until we’re ready to make the update available to everyone.

notes.title: Beta Update - New Network solution
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Beta has undergone a major network update, and a new network solution has been implemented. We’ve also solved a bunch of other issues, including some with the fill tool.

While we can’t promise no one will ever disconnect anymore, thanks to optimized reconnecting and host promotion, the game experience should be much better. 😊

Go check out Beta yourselves to see all the many added features and additional settings, like Pixel Art mode, Invisibility Mode and AI mode – and of course our well-known Lobby Drawing!

Thank you for your patience with the team. 
Stay tuned for more exciting (huge) updates coming this year!

notes.title: Choose your favourite game version during startup
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have rolled out an update to Draw & Guess that will now let you run either the Live or Beta version of the game during startup. 

In preparation of a larger update we have planned, our team has been hard at work completely revamping our multiplayer servers from scratch. 

We have been able to resolve many of the early issues with this system, though are still experiencing a few remaining bugs that can cause lobbies to drop out/players being unable to connect. 

To conduct necessary tests, we have updated the main game to the beta version, which includes:
- Lobby Drawing
- New networking system 
- More drawing tools 
- Variable brush sizes
- A new AI Game Mode ([b]Solo [/b]+ Multiplayer)
- Improved lobby browser
- Greyscale Colours
- Various bug fixes

With previous rollouts, players that encountered bugs/issues to the point of disrupting gameplay were unable to revert to the previous version.

From today, we will no longer overwrite the live version of the game, and instead will display a notification letting you know when we've made an update to Beta. We hope that this will help eliminate any disruptions during our update periods. 

Once we are confident that our Beta version is more stable than the live version, we will make the full upgrade! 

Thank you all for your support and happy drawing!

(We have some [i]very[/i] exciting things in store for you in the future 😉 )

- Draw & Guess Team

notes.title: Update Notes for 10 August
notes.notes:
Hello!

While we are diligently working on making the network solution of Beta more robust for release, [b]the official version now has a [i]300-seconds game mode[/i][/b]! 
This is for all you players who love to create big works of art. ːdgloveː

As part of the update, we've also changed the 120-seconds mode to 150 seconds, and have tweaked Fast Mode a bit so a 300s image does not take minutes to show. Thank you for playing!

If you want to already check out the features that will become available with the next major release, take a look at public Beta! Here's how to activate it:
- Right-click on Draw & Guess in your game list.
- Select “Properties…” > “Betas”.
- Pick “beta – DG Beta Branch” from the drop down.
The game automatically updates. Once it is done, it will display as “Draw & Guess [beta]” in your game list.

[b]TLDR:[/b]
- New 300s game mode
- 120s game mode changed to 150s
- Fast Mode adapted to display complex pictures faster
- Go check out Beta :)

notes.title: Update for 02 June - A new game mode supporting 2-16 players!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you for playing Draw&Guess. :-)

Here is the changelog for this update:

[list]
[*] New game mode for 2-16 players: One player draws, everyone else can guess. The faster you guess, the more points you get!
[*] In the next 1-2 days, the game will support Steam Trading Cards - they will drop automatically as you play!
[*] When a game is cancelled due to too many player disconnecting, players are now returned to the lobby and get a notification instead of a sudden disconnect
[*] Timer is now visible even after you have submitted so you can see how much time is remaining
[*] Hosts can now pause the game
[*] There is now a time limit for voting on words and favourite images
[*] Redone Chinese localisation
[*] French default word list now without noun markers
[*] You can now use Ctrl-Z to undo the last stroke
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking on the small selector for brush options caused an undo action
[/list]

Also, we have carefully read your reviews, many of them addressing network issues. The game makes use of Steam Networking, which means the lobby owner is the server. If they disconnect, the game can not recover. As many of you have mentioned, robustness against some connection instability would be nice. This is not easy to implement, but it is one of the top-priority item on our list of features to come!

Please also note that the new game mode will be improved in the coming weeks regarding UI and comfort features. Feedback is very welcome! 

If you mention anything weird with the game, please don't hesitate to send logs to me ( chikari@t-online.de ) - you can reach the log files by clicking "Logs" in the bottom left corner of the main menu (The files are called Player.log and Player-prev.log). This will help us a lot to fix bugs quickly!

Thank you for your patience and keep drawing :-)
